item.title: I secured my Bitcoin with two YubiKeys
item.description: No hardware wallet. My Bitcoin is guarded by two YubiKeys I already use daily, a sentence I memorized, and a printed paper. Here is what I understand, and what I do not.

item.title: My old iPad already had 7 years of my health data
item.description: An old iPad, an AI assistant that reads it, and a switch that had been off since install: how cross-checking wide health history from watch and scale works, and why the numbers stay off this site.

item.title: I configured a better shell. Then forgot how to use it.
item.description: I built a Raycast extension to surface the shell commands I keep forgetting. Installing better tools is easy. Using them is the problem.

item.title: I made my phone the brain of my AI agents
item.description: Five months of running Hermes Agent on an old Android phone: the vault is the asset, the agent is a replaceable part, and most of the work is keeping it alive.
